title: Mistral AI expands Studio platform with managed agents and workflows
excerpt: The updated enterprise AI platform allows developers to build and deploy automated agents and workflows across cloud or on-premises environments.
bodyHtml:
Mistral AI announced on November 5, 2026, the expansion of its enterprise AI platform, Mistral Studio. The update introduces managed agents and apps alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.

The platform lets teams activate models quickly through agents, workflows and apps connected to enterprise data and systems. Users can deploy them in the cloud, in a VPC, on-premises or across a combination of environments while retaining full control over the created intelligence.

Through the new Mistral MCP server, developers can test locally and deploy to their Studio environment with one command. Studio manages the runtime and hosting, enabling teams to build on that foundation to get each new use case into production faster.
topic: Le Chonk brings the brains. Studio puts it to work.
